title: Birthday Cake Pancakes

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday cake protein powder

ingredients.label: Eggs
ingredients.text: 3–4 egg whites

ingredients.label: Flour/Base
ingredients.text: ½ cup oat flour

ingredients.label: Liquid
ingredients.text: ½ cup almond milk

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia to taste

ingredients.label: Flavor/Extras
ingredients.text: ½ tsp vanilla extract + sugar-free sprinkles

steps.t: In a bowl, whisk the egg whites until slightly frothy.
Add protein powder and oat flour. Mix well.
Pour in almond milk gradually while stirring until the batter is smooth and pourable.
Add stevia and vanilla extract. Mix again.
Gently fold in sugar-free sprinkles.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour small portions of batter into the pan.
Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook another 1–2 minutes.

tip: Serve warm. You can top with Greek yogurt, berries, or a light drizzle of almond butter.

title: Brownie Pancakes

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Eggs
ingredients.text: 3–4 egg whites

ingredients.label: Flour/Base
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp cocoa powder + 2 tbsp oat flour

ingredients.label: Liquid
ingredients.text: ½ cup almond milk

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia to taste

ingredients.label: Optional
ingredients.text: 1–2 tsp sugar-free chocolate chips

steps.t: In a bowl, whisk the egg whites until slightly frothy.
Add protein powder, cocoa powder, and oat flour. Mix well.
Slowly pour in almond milk while stirring until the batter is smooth and pourable (not too thin).
Add stevia and mix again. Fold in chocolate chips if using.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour small portions of batter into the pan.
Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook another 1–2 minutes.

tip: Serve warm. You can top with Greek yogurt, berries, or a drizzle of almond butter.

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday cake or Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Eggs
ingredients.text: 3–4 egg whites

ingredients.label: Flour/Base
ingredients.text: ¼ cup oat or almond flour

ingredients.label: Liquid
ingredients.text: ½ cup almond milk

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia to taste

ingredients.label: Flavor/Extras
ingredients.text: Vanilla waffles: ½ tsp vanilla extract / Chocolate waffles: cocoa powder

steps.t: Preheat waffle maker and lightly grease.
Protein powder + flour (+ cocoa if making chocolate).
Egg whites, almond milk, stevia, and vanilla (if using).
Whisk until smooth. Adjust with a splash of milk if too thick.
Cook 3–5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Serve immediately with berries, nut butter, or yogurt.

title: Crepes with Fruit Filling

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday cake protein powder

ingredients.label: Eggs
ingredients.text: 1 whole egg

ingredients.label: Flour/Base
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp oat flour

ingredients.label: Liquid
ingredients.text: ½ cup almond milk

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia to taste

ingredients.label: Filling
ingredients.text: Sliced strawberries, blueberries, or sugar-free fruit spread

ingredients.label: Flavor/Extras
ingredients.text: Vanilla extract for vanilla crepes

steps.t: Prepare batter: In a bowl, whisk together protein powder, oat flour, egg, almond milk, stevia, and a splash of vanilla extract until smooth and thin. The batter should be pourable (thinner than pancake batter).
Heat pan: Lightly grease a non-stick pan and heat over medium-low.
Cook crepes: Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and swirl immediately to spread thin. Cook 1–2 minutes until edges lift, flip, and cook another 30–60 seconds. Repeat with remaining batter.
Fill & fold: Add sliced strawberries, blueberries, or sugar-free fruit spread down the center. Fold or roll gently.

tip: Serve warm. Optional: top with extra berries or a light dusting of protein powder for a bakery-style finish.

title: Chocolate Banana Muffins

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Eggs
ingredients.text: 3–4 egg whites

ingredients.label: Flour/Base
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp oat flour

ingredients.label: Liquid
ingredients.text: ½ cup alomad milk

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: 1 whole mashed banana + stevia

ingredients.label: Flavor/Extras
ingredients.text: 1–2 tsp cocoa powder + 1–2 tsp sugar-free chocolate chips

steps.t: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line or lightly grease a muffin tin.
Protein powder, oat flour, cocoa powder.
Egg whites, almond milk, mashed banana, and stevia.
Mix until smooth. Fold in sugar-free chocolate chips.
Divide batter evenly into muffin cups (about ¾ full).
Bake 12–18 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 5–10 minutes before removing.

tip: Store in the fridge up to 4 days or freeze for meal prep.

title: Chocolate Brownie

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia + optional dark chocolate chips or walnuts

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder + 3 tbsp almond flour

ingredients.label: Texture
ingredients.text: ¼ cup almond milk + 1 tbsp almond butter or coconut oil

steps.t: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line or lightly grease a small baking dish.
Protein powder, cocoa powder, almond flour, and stevia.
Almond milk and almond butter (or melted coconut oil).
Stir until smooth and thick. Fold in optional dark chocolate chips or walnuts.
Bake 12–18 minutes for fudgy texture (slightly longer for cakier).
Cool at least 10 minutes before slicing to set properly.

tip: Store in the fridge up to 4 days. For extra fudgy texture, chill before serving.

title: Apple Crumble

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday Cake protein powder

ingredients.label: Fruit
ingredients.text: 1 small apple diced

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: ¼ cup rolled oats + 1 tbsp oat flour or almond flour

ingredients.label: Fat
ingredients.text: 1 tsp butter or coconut oil (melted)

ingredients.label: Flavor
ingredients.text: ½ tsp cinnamon + ½ tsp lemon juice + pinch of salt

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: 1 tsp maple syrup or stevia (optional)

ingredients.label: Moisture
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp water + splash of milk if needed

ingredients.label: Optional Crunch
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp chopped nuts or seeds

steps.t: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease a small baking dish or ramekin.
In a bowl, mix diced apple with lemon juice, cinnamon, pinch of salt, sweetener (if using), and 1 tbsp water. Spread into the baking dish.
In another bowl, combine protein powder, rolled oats, oat/almond flour, melted butter or coconut oil, and a small splash of milk if needed. Mix until crumbly. Fold in optional nuts or seeds.
Sprinkle topping evenly over apples.
Bake 18–25 minutes until golden and apples are soft.
Cool slightly before serving to allow it to set.

tip: Optional: serve with Greek yogurt or a drizzle of almond butter for extra protein.

title: Cinnamon Rolls

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday Cake protein powder

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: ¼ cup oat flour + 1 tsp baking powder

ingredients.label: Texture
ingredients.text: 3 tbsp almond milk + 1 tsp coconut oil or almond butter

ingredients.label: Filling
ingredients.text: 1 tsp cinnamon + stevia

ingredients.label: Optional Icing
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp unsweetened coconut yogurt + stevia + vanilla extract

steps.t: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line or lightly grease a small baking dish.
In a bowl, mix protein powder, oat flour, baking powder, and stevia.
Add almond milk and coconut oil (or almond butter).
Stir until a soft dough forms. If too dry, add 1 tsp milk at a time.
Place dough between two sheets of parchment and roll into a small rectangle.
Sprinkle cinnamon and stevia evenly over the surface.
Roll tightly into a log and slice into rolls.
Bake 12–15 minutes until lightly golden.
Mix coconut yogurt, stevia, and vanilla extract.
Spread over warm rolls before serving.

tip: Best enjoyed warm for a soft, gooey texture.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday Cake or Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia + 1 tbsp sugar-free dark chocolate chips

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: 3 tbsp almond flour + 1 tbsp coconut flour + ¼ tsp vanilla extract

ingredients.label: Texture
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp melted coconut oil or almond butter + 2 tbsp almond milk

steps.t: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Mix dry ingredients: Protein powder, almond flour, coconut flour, and stevia.
Add wet ingredients: Melted coconut oil (or almond butter), almond milk, and vanilla extract. Mix until a soft dough forms. Fold in sugar-free chocolate chips.
Shape cookies: Form small balls, place on tray, and gently flatten (they won’t spread much).
Bake 8–12 minutes until edges are lightly golden.
Cool completely before handling to allow them to firm up.

tip: Store in an airtight container up to 4 days.

title: Carrot Cake Bliss Balls

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday Cake protein powder

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia or ½ tsp maple syrup

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp oat flour + ½ tbsp almond butter

ingredients.label: Flavor
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp finely grated carrot + ¼ tsp cinnamon + tiny pinch of nutmeg

ingredients.label: Texture
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp unsweetened almond milk

ingredients.label: Optional
ingredients.text: 1 tsp shredded coconut or chopped walnuts for crunch

steps.t: Protein powder, oat flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and sweetener.
Almond butter, grated carrot, and almond milk.
Mix until a soft dough forms. If too dry, add a few drops of milk.
Fold in shredded coconut or chopped walnuts.
Roll mixture into small bite-sized balls.
Chill 15–20 minutes to firm up before serving.

tip: Store in the fridge up to 5 days. Perfect as a quick high-protein snack.

title: Chocolate Peanut Candy Bar

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday Cake or Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia + optional sugar-free dark chocolate drizzle

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp peanut butter + 1 tbsp oat flour

ingredients.label: Texture
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp almond milk + optional crushed peanuts for crunch

steps.t: Mix dry ingredients: Protein powder, oat flour, and stevia.
Add wet ingredients: Peanut butter and almond milk. Mix until a thick, moldable dough forms. Fold in crushed peanuts if using.
Shape: Press mixture firmly into a small lined container or shape into bar form.
Chill 20–30 minutes until firm.
Optional drizzle: Add melted sugar-free dark chocolate on top and chill again to set.

tip: Store in the fridge up to 5 days. Best enjoyed slightly chilled for a candy-bar texture.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Bites

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday cake protein powder

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp oat flour or almond flour,

ingredients.label: Creaminess
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp Greek yogurt (nonfat or lowfat)

ingredients.label: Flavor
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp mashed strawberries + ¼ tsp vanilla extract

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia or ½ tsp maple syrup

ingredients.label: Optional
ingredients.text: 1 tsp crushed graham crackers or oats for topping

steps.t: Combine protein powder and oat or almond flour in a bowl.
Stir in Greek yogurt, mashed strawberries, vanilla extract, and sweetener.
Mix until smooth and thick.
Roll into small bite-sized balls or press into mini silicone molds.
Sprinkle crushed graham crackers or oats on top.
Chill 20–30 minutes until firm.

tip: Store in the fridge up to 4–5 days. Best served cold for a cheesecake texture.

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Vanilla Birthday cake or Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia or ½ tsp maple syrup + 1 tbsp sugar-free dark chocolate chips

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp oat flour + 1 tbsp almond butter

ingredients.label: Texture
ingredients.text: 1–2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk (add gradually until creamy)

steps.t: In a bowl, mix the protein powder and oat flour.
Add almond butter and 1 tbsp almond milk. Stir until combined.
Slowly add more almond milk (½ tbsp at a time) until it reaches a cookie dough consistency (thick, not runny).
Add stevia or maple syrup and mix.
Fold in the sugar-free chocolate chips. Chill for 5–10 minutes if you want it thicker

title: Chocolate Hazelnut Cups

ingredients.label: Protein
ingredients.text: 2 scoops of NutriBae plant-based Chocolate Brownie Delight protein powder

ingredients.label: Sweetness
ingredients.text: Stevia

ingredients.label: Base
ingredients.text: 2 tbsp natural hazelnut butter + 1 tbsp cocoa powder

ingredients.label: Texture
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp coconut oil (melted) + 1 tbsp crushed hazelnuts (optional)

steps.t: In a bowl, mix the protein powder and cocoa powder.
Add hazelnut butter and melted coconut oil. Stir until smooth and fully combined.
Add stevia to taste and mix again.
Fold in crushed hazelnuts if using.
Spoon the mixture into silicone molds or mini cupcake liners.
Freeze for 15–20 minutes until firm.

tip: Store in the fridge or freezer for a firmer texture
